headline: YouTube says it isn't testing hiding the dislike button
summary: YouTube confirms it's not testing hiding the dislike button. Reports stemmed from user screenshots on X. A spokesperson clarified no such test is underway.

headline: Tesla targets 2026 for customer-owned robotaxi fleet
summary: Tesla announced a Q3 2026 target for customer-owned vehicles to join its robotaxi fleet. This promise follows years of similar, unfulfilled statements from Elon Musk. The deadline was set during the company's recent earnings call.

headline: New data centers threaten decades of air quality progress
summary: A surge of new data centers, particularly in Texas, could erase decades of air quality gains. These centers demand immense electricity, often sourced from gas plants. This energy demand risks returning air pollution to 2000s levels.

headline: Meta to issue new share class for AI funding
summary: Meta plans to issue a new class of non-voting shares. These shares will fund AI initiatives, potential acquisitions, and employee compensation. Trading for this new stock class is expected to begin in 2027.

headline: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Narrows Release Window Following Player Feedback
summary: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 now has a narrower release window: second half of 2027. This update shortens the previous 12-month window to six months. The adjustment comes following feedback from players.

headline: Brandon Sanderson Wants to Know Who Really Wrote the Mr. Beast Book
summary: Author Brandon Sanderson is questioning the true authorship of the Mr. Beast book. The query highlights concerns about influencer-led publishing projects. Sanderson's comments have sparked debate in the literary community.

headline: GTA's Burger Shot opening in real life
summary: Grand Theft Auto's iconic fast-food restaurant, Burger Shot, is coming to real life. A physical Burger Shot will open in the Miami Heat's arena. This launch precedes the highly anticipated release of GTA 6.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Review So Far
summary: The new DMZ mode in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has made a strong first impression. It's described as a significantly improved and expanded version. Early reviews indicate a promising experience for players.

headline: Burnham defends Jackdaw, Badenoch urges end to oil ban
summary: Burnham defends the controversial Jackdaw gas field decision. Kemi Badenoch urges the Prime Minister to overturn the ban on new oil and gas licences. The UK government suggests the field could start producing gas this month.

headline: Critical PHP vulnerability takes down websites globally
summary: Websites worldwide were affected by a critical cyber-security update. The vulnerability was found in PHP, a programming language widely used across the internet. It's described as the most significant AI-discovered flaw ever.

headline: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
summary: Kyiv was hit by missiles despite Russia agreeing to resume Ukraine peace talks. Moscow stated it is 'ready in principle' for negotiations. US President Trump claims the world is 'closest we've been' to ending the war.

headline: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
summary: The BBC's Russia Editor suggests a US diplomatic push offers little hope for immediate Ukraine peace. President Vladimir Putin reportedly feels no current pressure to end the war. The assessment highlights ongoing challenges to a resolution.
